title: Features
subtitle: Everything you need to keep your add-ons organized, up to date and ready for your next adventure in Tamriel.

items.title: Install, update and remove add-ons
items.description: Manage your ESO add-ons from a single application without manually handling every installation or update.

items.title: Synchronize add-ons and libraries
items.description: Synchronize managed add-ons and their associated libraries.

items.title: Dependency management
items.description: Detect and resolve required dependencies. Some dependencies may require a user selection.

items.title: Scan for existing add-ons
items.description: Discover add-ons already present in your AddOns folder and review them before your first synchronization.

items.title: Synchronization on launch
items.description: Optionally synchronize managed add-ons when the application starts.

items.title: Library management
items.description: Manage shared libraries alongside your installed add-ons.

items.title: Exclusions
items.description: Exclude selected add-ons or folders from synchronization according to the application's available settings.

items.title: Custom ZIP add-ons
items.description: Add custom add-ons distributed as ZIP archives.

items.title: Favourites
items.description: Mark add-ons as favourites for convenient access.

items.title: Tamriel Trade Centre price tables
items.description: Update TTC price tables during synchronization when the corresponding add-on is installed and the feature is applicable.

items.title: Diagnostic logs and settings
items.description: Review diagnostic information and configure the application to suit your setup.
